title: 谷歌面临另一起来自主要出版商的人工智能培训诉讼
content: 阿歇特 (Hachette)、圣智 (Cengage)、爱思唯尔 (Elsevier) 和其他出版商声称，谷歌在未经必要许可的情况下在受版权保护的作品上训练其人工智能。
original_title: Google faces another AI training lawsuit from major publishers
original_content: Hachette, Cengage, Elsevier, and other publishers allege that Google trained its AI on copyrighted works without the necessary permissions.

title: OpenAI 研究员 Miles Wang 正在洽谈创办估值 20 亿美元的人工智能药物发现初创公司
content: 融资讨论表明投资者有兴趣应用人工智能在生命科学领域取得突破。
original_title: OpenAI researcher Miles Wang in talks to launch AI drug discovery startup valued at $2B
original_content: The funding discussions point to investor interest in applying AI to make breakthroughs in life sciences.

title: OpenAI 反击苹果商业秘密诉讼
content: OpenAI 就该诉讼发表了另一份声明，这次表明该诉讼缺乏法律依据。
original_title: OpenAI pushes back on Apple trade secret lawsuit
original_content: OpenAI has issued another statement on the lawsuit, this time suggesting it lacks merit.

title: DOGE 将人工智能用于住房政策。政府不会透露如何做
content: 为了响应公共记录请求，HUD 扣留了有关 DOGE 使用人工智能的文件，部分原因是引用了不存在的特权。
original_title: DOGE Used AI for Housing Policy. The Government Won’t Say How
original_content: In response to a public records request, HUD has withheld documents about DOGE’s use of AI—in part by citing a privilege that doesn’t exist.

title: 人们不断警告 OpenAI 新旗舰机型会自行删除文件
content: 许多社交媒体帖子声称 GPT-5.6 Sol 在没有警告的情况下删除了文件和数据。 OpenAI在6月份就基本披露了这个问题。
original_title: OpenAI’s new flagship model deletes files on its own, people keep warning
original_content: A number of social media posts claim that GPT-5.6 Sol deleted files and data without warning. OpenAI had basically disclosed the problem in June.

title: 苹果通过 iOS 27 公开测试版向所有人开放新的 Siri AI
content: 如果您一直在等待在不安装开发者测试版的情况下尝试苹果改进的 Siri，那么现在您可以了。该公司周二发布了 iOS 27 公开测试版，让 iPhone 用户可以在该软件于今年秋天正式发布之前抢先体验其人工智能助手和其他新功能。
original_title: Apple opens its new Siri AI to everyone with the iOS 27 public beta
original_content: If you’ve been waiting to try Apple’s revamped Siri without installing a developer beta, you now can. The company on Tuesday released the iOS 27 public beta, giving iPhone owners early access to its AI-powered assistant and other new features before the software’s official launch this fall.

title: 美国政府警告俄罗斯国家黑客正在攻击你的路由器
content: 随着住宅代理风靡一时，CISA 敦促路由器用户保持警惕。
original_title: The US government warns that Russia state hackers are coming after your router
original_content: With residential proxies all the rage, CISA urges router users to be vigilant.

title: Reflection 与 Nebius 签署 10 亿美元计算协议
content: Reflection AI 已签署价值 10 亿美元的协议来访问 Nebius 的计算。 Reflection成立于2024年，正在开发开源人工智能技术。
